newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar shares edge firmer in the week.
newsitem.headline: Qatar shares edge firmer in the week.

text.p: Shares on Qatar's unofficial market kept their steady advance in the week to Thursday, brokers said.
The 18-share Commercial Bank of Qatar (CBQ) index moved up a fraction to 121.25 points from a previous 120.97.
Seven shares rose and 11 remained steady.
Among the gainers were Qatar Navigation which rose 10 riyals to 710 and Qatar General Insurance which jumped five riyals to 535.

Al-Khaleej Insurance gained four riyals to 292 and Doha Bank Ltd three riyals to 273. Qatar Cinema advanced two riyals to 177. Qatar Cement added three riyals to 303 and Qatar Flour Mills was two riyals firmer at 305.
